text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps I should say, as expected—
You look to be in top form, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone,
please take good care of me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove-senpai... what an incredible aura, as expected.
And Bright looks right at home standing beside her now.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Besides... Suzuka.
A uniquely formidable Umamusume who pulls off an otherworldly lead with her terrifying legs...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Even so... the opponents I need to face today
aren't just those three.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (...I'm not even at that stage yet.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(First, I have to... conquer myself.
I have to overcome my weak self...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, Suzuka, the fiercer
your pursuers' fighting spirit, the more your heart races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then by all means, look forward to it.
...Today is bound to be quite delightful."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show me what you've got, Dober—!
